subject: Proposal: PromptSure marketplace bundle + Redwood SDK compatibility
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well — I'm Alex, Head of Partnerships at PromptSure. We build a prompt QA and prompt-store product used by ~40 ISVs to track prompt drift and run prompt-only evals. We've had a few customers asking for a tighter integration with Redwood (both hosted API and private deployments) so we can show cost-per-eval and token-attribution inside our product.

High-level idea: a lightweight compatibility layer in Redwood's SDKs that exposes a small instrumentation API (trace id + token counts + model variant metadata) and a turnkey marketplace bundle for PromptSure that installs a preconfigured eval pipeline for Private/Dedicated customers. We think this could be a co-sell/marketplace bundle with a small revenue split.

Would you be open to a quick 30-min call next week to explore feasibility and which Redwood teams to loop in (runtime/tracing, integrations, and partnerships)? I'll attach a short tech-scope.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Partnerships, PromptSure
alex@promptsure.ai
Attachment: PromptSure_tech-scope.pdf (1 page, overview)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Alex — thanks for the note and the attachment. This is aligned with a lot of asks we've been seeing from customers that want tighter prompt observability tied to token costs. Happy to kick off a scoping call.

Suggested attendees from our side: me (partnerships), Marissa (product/ISV partnerships), Jonas (runtime/instrumentation), and Vanessa (marketplace/commercial). Can you do 30 minutes on Thursday or Friday next week? Also, please share a short mutual action plan if you have one.

On scope: the key things we care about are (1) low-latency instrumentation that doesn't add per-token overhead, (2) compatibility with Redwood Private (VPC) installs where customers can't allow outbound calls, and (3) a clean package for our marketplace certification.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Alex — great to meet you virtually. Quick notes from product/partnership POV before the call:

- We like a two-track approach: a) instrumentation shim (open-source-friendly) for hosted & dedicated runtimes; b) an installable bundle for Private that runs entirely inside customer networks (no outbound telemetry by default).
- Our marketplace certification will require an install checklist (dependencies, installation path, resource footprint) and an SLA/rollback plan.
- For commercial packaging, marketplace bundles typically include a 90-day trial + a baseline per-seat or per-eval fee. Vanessa will coordinate pricing.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min scoping call (we'll bring a short checklist)
2) PromptSure provides a short mutual-action-plan (MVP scope + docs)
3) We do a quick technical spike (2 sprints) for Private installability

I can join the initial call on Thursday 10th or Friday 11th — any preference?

Thanks, Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, ISV Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Alex / team — a few technical clarifications I want covered on the call so we can size the spike:

1) Instrumentation surface: are you looking for per-request headers only (trace-id, prompt-id) + aggregated token counts, or do you need token-level payloads? Token-level payloads will be a non-starter for Private by default.
2) Model variants: do you need exact model config (quantization, compiled kernels) or just model name + sequence-length estimate? We prefer minimal labels for routing/fallback reasons.
3) Transport: for Private installs we can't allow outbound telemetry. Would PromptSure ship a containerized agent that writes to a customer-managed S3/MinIO or push to a customer telemetry endpoint?

If you can outline answers to these three items in advance, we can prepare a rough spike plan.

Jonas
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Rao <prao@marketplace.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Thanks Jonas — answers inline: 

1) Instrumentation surface: per-request headers (trace-id, prompt-id, request-duration) + aggregated token counts per request is our MVP. No token payloads.
2) Model variants: model name + model_size (e.g., llama-3-7b, llama-3-70b) + an optional quantization tag is sufficient for our analyses.
3) Transport: for Private installs we will provide a containerized agent that can be deployed inside the customer's VPC and either (a) write aggregated reports to S3/MinIO, or (b) accept pulls from a customer analytics endpoint. We will not require outbound calls by default.

Attached is a short mutual-action-plan and a marketplace bundle pricing draft. Let us know if those are a helpful starting point and we can iterate.

—Alex
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, marketplace-bundle-pricing-v1.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@promptsure.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyanka Rao <prao@marketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + lightweight SDK compatibility idea for PromptSure & Redwood

Alex — thanks for the clear answers and the attachments, these are very helpful. Follow-up items from Redwood side and proposed timeline: 

- Internal spike (Jonas + 1 engineer): 2 sprints (approx Jan 4 — Jan 17) to produce an open-source shim in our SDKs that adds the requested per-request headers and aggregated token counters (no per-token payloads).
- Private install validation: PromptSure to provide containerized agent image and a short deployment guide by Jan 10. Redwood marketplace team (Vanessa) will run the certification checklist during week of Jan 18.
- Commercial: Vanessa to propose a marketplace bundle price and 90-day trial by Jan 12.
- Mutual action plan: we'll use the spreadsheet you attached as the working doc and add owners/dates.

Could you confirm PromptSure can deliver the container by Jan 10 and that your engineering lead (Samir) can join a 30-min technical sync on Jan 6? If yes, I'll send calendar invites and a DocuSign NDA so Priyanka's marketplace team can review the licensing terms.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of ISV Partnerships, Redwood Inference
